column.text: The single most important signal dominating the market right now is a sustained $307M inflow into spot ETFs today while open interest expands, proving fresh institutional capital is entering rather than just speculative leverage. Despite BTC daily RSI hitting an overbought 82.28 and MACD histogram turning negative at -219 suggesting momentum decay, the fundamental flow remains robust with Strategy deploying its $2B cash pool and Lookonchain data showing Maji adding another $12M to long positions totaling roughly $87.44 million. This divergence between technical exhaustion on lower timeframes and massive buying pressure creates a high-probability continuation scenario for longs, provided price holds above the critical $81k support level where RSI mean reversion risks trigger a potential long squeeze. The tape is clearly up-trending in this Risk-On regime, yet dollar liquidity is contracting which forces traders to demand more proof on every rally and treat failed breakouts as superior short setups. While headlines celebrate Strive acquiring 1,110 BTC for $81.5M and Bitmine buying over 32k ETH validating Tom Lee's overdue upside thesis, the macro headwind requires caution against fading strength without a real catalyst like an overheated funding rate spike or supply unlock event. Short sellers must wait for genuine exhaustion signals rather than chasing tops on extended moves because institutional accumulation acts as a powerful floor preventing deep corrections even when retail sentiment turns fearful at Fear & Greed index levels of 73.
